chunks: O you who believe, when you marry believing women then divorce them before having (sexual) contact with them, you have no right to demand observance of the 'waiting period' of them. But provide suitably for them, and let them go with honour.

key_terms.عِدَّةٌ: Waiting period (period of waiting before remarriage)

ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a woman divorced before consummation in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this verse establishes the baseline for 'iddah, distinguishing between pre-consummation divorce, which requires only a brief waiting period (typically two menstrual cycles or three months), and post-consummation divorce. The obligation of 'mut'ah' (gracious provision) serves as a compensatory right for the wife, reflecting the Prophet's practice and the Imams' emphasis on dignified treatment even when the marital bond is not fully realized.
